LanguageData.PhobosSling_WarnWeather: {WEATHER} Lift anyway and the swinging load strains the hook's mount by a quarter of its health; a mount strained to nothing gives way and drops the load.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_WarnOverload: {LOAD} weighs {WEIGHT} kg, more than the {CAPACITY} kg the hook lifts today. Lift it anyway and the hook's mount loses health in step with the overload; if it gives way, the load drops.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_Strained: The {HELICOPTER}'s hook mount took the strain of that lift and lost {SHARE} of its health. It needs a repair before it gives way.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_GaveWay: The {HELICOPTER}'s hook mount gave way under {LOAD}. It dropped back to the ground: {HARM}. The hook is gone until the mount is repaired.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_CutEnginesDesc: Cut the {VEHICLE}'s engines here and now, in the air. It falls where it is: everyone aboard is hurt as in a fall with no power, a load on the hook drops, and over a building, rough ground or water it is wrecked.\n\nTo land and switch off safely, switch its engines off the ordinary way instead.
LanguageData.PhobosFlight_WhyEnginesCut: its engines were cut in the air
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_WarnTooHeavy: {TOWED} weighs {WEIGHT} kg, more than the {LIMIT} kg {TRACTOR} should tow. It will go, slowly, and the weight wears {TRACTOR}'s brakes and clutch fast.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgClutchWornThroug: The {VEHICLE}'s clutch is worn through. It takes up only a quarter of the drive, so it crawls and labours on any slope; a mechanic should fit a new one.
